observations: Photo 0 shows a wooden pallet lying on a concrete floor; light-colored timber slats with dark gaps; visible nails/screws at some corners.
Photo 1 shows the same style of wooden pallet from a different angle; the pallet deck boards and stringers are visible; no clear brand markings.
Photo 2 shows a stack/rack of wooden pallets; some pallets appear darker/older; construction looks like standard pallet stringer design.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic and does not describe the specific pallet’s condition, size, grade, or quantity.

risks.risk: Unknown pallet size/grade (e.g., 4-way vs 2-way, standard vs custom dimensions) which affects what it can carry and the going rate.
risks.proof: Ask for a tape-measure photo showing length x width x height, and whether forks can enter from 2 sides or 4 sides.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic wooden pallet with unknown dimensions/grade (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Condition issues (broken boards, loose nails, cracks, insect damage) that reduce usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all 4 corners and underside/stringers, plus one photo showing any broken/loose slats.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as usable but not guaranteed (worst-case: treat as needing minor repairs).

risks.risk: Heat treatment/ISPM-15 compliance status (important for export and sometimes for buyers who require it).
risks.proof: Photo of the stamp/mark on the pallet (ISPM-15/IPPC mark) and any serial/producer code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified compliance (worst-case: assume no usable certification).

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (photos show at least one pallet and a stack, but the exact number for sale is unclear).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact quantity being sold (count) and a photo showing the full stack with a visible count method.
risks.if_unproven: Priced per pallet as the safest assumption until quantity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Confirm exact quantity for sale (how many pallets).
Provide pallet dimensions (L x W x H) with a tape measure in-frame.
Show underside/stringers and all corners (close-ups) to confirm no broken/loose boards.
Provide a clear photo of any stamp/mark on the pallet (ISPM-15/IPPC) if present.
response.reason: From the photos, it’s clearly a wooden pallet, but key pricing drivers are missing remotely: exact dimensions/grade, condition details, compliance stamp, and the exact quantity being sold. Without these, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
